name: Hard or impossible to use
about: Accessibility, or an interface that fights you
title: ''

---

**What happened, and what did you expect?**

**Where?** URL or screen.

**What are you using?** Browser and version, plus screen reader / magnification / voice
control / keyboard-only if any. "I do not know, it is whatever came with my phone" is a
useful answer — say that rather than nothing.

---

Some of these projects gate their builds on automated accessibility checks. Those checks
cannot tell what a screen reader actually announces, and no automated tool can. A report from
someone using one outranks the audit suite and will not be closed as "the linter passes".
